verdict.rationale: Smart Capture Link is documented as a low-/no-code hosted verification link that can be sent to customers without engineering effort, directly matching the 'no-code link' half of the story, and Workflow Studio lets ops configure flows without developers. However, there is no explicit mention of QR-code generation or a self-service dashboard flow for an ops lead to generate one-off links without any setup, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of ease-of-use. Missing for 10: explicit QR-code support, evidence of an ops-only self-service link-generation UI, and independent corroboration.
